Tests that identical chat requests return cached response

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from liter_llm import create_client_from_json
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import ChatCompletionRequest

async def main() -> None:
    client = create_client_from_json("{\"api_key\":\"your-api-key\",\"cache\":{\"backend\":\"memory\",\"max_entries\":256,\"ttl_seconds\":300}}")
    req = ChatCompletionRequest.from_json("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Hello\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\"}")
    result = await client.chat(req)
    print(result)

asyncio.run(main())
```
